# proxmox_sdn_route_map_entries (Data Source)

Lists staged SDN route map entries from `/cluster/sdn/route-maps/entries`, sorted by route map then order. Requires `route_map_id` because orders are only unique per route map.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_route_map_entries" "inbound" {
  route_map_id = "inbound"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `route_map_id` (String) Route map whose entries are listed.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Matching entries, sorted by `order`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String)
- `order` (Number)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `route_map_id` (String)
- `state` (String)
